name: Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (GSKVN)
benefit: 1. An individual loan of ₹1,00,000/- is provided. 1. The interest rate on the loan is 4%. 1. The loan is intended for various businesses/occupations such as Mandap Decoration, Computer, Electrical Shop, Animal Husbandry, Grocery Shop, Bamboo Work, Sewing Work, Embroidery, Beauty Parlour, Mobile Repairing, etc.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a native resident of Gujarat State. 1. The applicant must be a sanitation worker or a dependent woman. 1. The applicant must be female. 1. The applicant's age should not be less than 18 years and not more than 50 years on the date of the advertisement.
